title: Provincial Motor Vehicles North-West Frontier Province Amendment Act 2009

sections.shortTitle: Provincial Motor Vehicles North-West Frontier Province Amendment Act 2009
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT IX OF 2009
ACT IX OF 2009
PROVINCIAL MOTOR
VEHICLES (NORTH-WEST
FRONTIER PROVINCE) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2009
An Act to amend the
Provincial Motor
Vehicle Ordinance, 1965
[Gazette of N.-W.F.P.
Extraordinary,
28th March, 2009]
No.PA/NWFP/Bills/2009/11778, dated
28-3-2009.---The Provincial Motor Vehicles North-West
Frontier Province (Amendment) Bill, 2009 having been passed by the Provincial
Assembly of North-West Frontier Province on 17th March, 2009 and assented to by
the Governor of the North-West Frontier Province on 20th March, 2009 is hereby
published as an Act of the Provincial Legislature of the North-West Frontier
Province.
Preamble.---Whereas it is expedient further
to amend the Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965 (W.P. Ord. No.XIX of 1965) for the
purposes hereinafter apeparing;
It is hereby enacted as follows:--
1. Short title and commencement.---(1)
This Act may be called the Provincial Motor Vehicles (North-West Frontier
Province) (Amendment) Act, 2009.
(2) It shall come into force at once.

28-3-2009.---The Provincial Motor Vehicles North-West

Assembly of North-West Frontier Province on 17th March, 2009 and assented to by
the Governor of the North-West Frontier Province on 20th March, 2009 is hereby
published as an Act of the Provincial Legislature of the North-West Frontier
Province.
Preamble.---Whereas it is expedient further
to amend the Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965 (W.P. Ord. No.XIX of 1965) for the
purposes hereinafter apeparing;
It is hereby enacted as follows:--
2. General Amendments in W.P. Ord. No.XIX of 1965.---In the
Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965 (W.P. Ord. No.XIX of 1965), in its application to the North-West
Frontier Province.---
(a) for the word
"District" and "Districts", wherever occurring, the word
"Region" and "Regions" shall respectively be substituted:
and
(b) for the
words "District Transport Authority", wherever occurring, the words
"Regional Transport Authority" shall be substituted.
